distance_definition: Number of agent/user turns after the causal clue and before fast-forward; includes the evaluated pre-gap action and user acknowledgement.
clue: The tenancy proof is in my flatmate's name, while I am the person filing for the permit.
clue_answer: the proof named the flatmate instead of the applicant
clue_ablation_text: I am not sure; I do not have the household documents available.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Hi, I am applying for a resident parking permit.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I can take you through that. Do you have the property reference?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Yes, it ends in three-one-seven.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: The eligibility check issues the permit only when the proof names the applicant; proof naming another occupant is refused.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Understood; I compared the names on the documents.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Do you need a visitor allowance as well?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: No, just the one permit.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Does the supporting proof name the same person who is applying for the permit?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: The tenancy proof is in my flatmate's name, while I am the person filing for the permit.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Would you like an annual or monthly permit?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Annual would be better.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Is the vehicle kept at the property overnight?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Yes, every night.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Do you know the registration plate?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Yes, I have it written down here.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Would you like the permit posted or collected?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Posted is easier for me.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: How many vehicles need covering?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Just the one.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Have you held a permit in this zone before?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: No, this is my first one.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Would you like a receipt by email?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Yes, email please.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Is the number ending in two-four-eight still current?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Yes, that is current.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Send the application into the automated eligibility check.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Okay, I will wait for the outcome.

permit_status.not_applied: the permit application has not been submitted
permit_status.in_check: the application is undergoing eligibility checks
permit_status.refused: the eligibility check denied the application
permit_status.issued: the permit was approved and issued

causal_alignment.misaligned: the supporting proof names someone other than the applicant
causal_alignment.aligned: the supporting proof names the permit applicant

pre_gap_actions.description: Send the application into the automated eligibility check.
Hand out a temporary permit before any check is run.
Send the whole thing straight to the appeals team.
Read the plate back once more before applying.
Close the request and ask the caller to apply again later.

post_gap_actions.description: Provide a different document that shows the applicant lives at the address.
Send the identical application through the check again now.
Read the plate back once more instead.
Leave the application alone and wait another interval.
Close the request because the checking interval has passed.

causal_post_gap_observation.text: Twenty-five minutes have passed and the eligibility check finished, but the decision is not shown. Based on the document detail I gave earlier, what should happen next?

response_styles.description: Briefly acknowledge the user's frustration or experienced impact before proceeding.
Acknowledge the time pressure and prioritize the immediate next step.
Briefly clarify the situation and reassure the user before proceeding.
Proceed directly and neutrally to the next operational step.

tag_definitions.EARLY_CLUE_LOSS: The selected action is attractive when the early clue is unavailable or unused.
tag_definitions.STATE_SYNC_FAILURE: The action treats the pre-gap world as if it still held after time advanced.
tag_definitions.TIME_INFERENCE_FAILURE: The action fails to use elapsed time when interpreting the observation.
tag_definitions.REPEATED_ACTION: The action repeats a step already attempted without a new justification.
tag_definitions.PREMATURE_CLOSE: The action closes an interaction whose state is unresolved.
tag_definitions.PREMATURE_ESCALATION: The action escalates before supported diagnostic or policy steps are exhausted.
tag_definitions.ACTION_SELECTION_FAILURE: The action is inconsistent with the current state but has no narrower failure label.
tag_definitions.PROSODY_GROUNDING_FAILURE: The response approach does not match the audible delivery.
tag_definitions.BELIEF_REPORT_INVALID: One or more required state-belief distributions or revalidation flags are missing or malformed.
tag_definitions.STATE_BELIEF_ERROR: At least one required checkpoint assigns its highest probability to the wrong hidden state.
